descriptions.g8a_release_channel_locks_8016b040: Releases selected channel array locks for an external owner and clears corresponding cached lock words and active marker. Chooses original lock modes1/2 using state bits29..26, with selected masks3/12/48/384; aggregate path uses bit30 and observed count guard. Single-owner empty-array fast path increments16-bit lock count at header28; otherwise calls original array lock801ef048 with start0 and stride8. Partial external views are never constructed locally; no owned data.
